$comment: Machine-readable design spec for neh-skill-repair-agent per the ai-agent-patterns design-record schema. This is an instance document, not a metaschema.

agent.name: neh-skill-repair-agent
agent.goal: Detect and repair mechanical defects across the installed NEH skill library; emit repaired .skill packages and a fail-closed report; escalate judgment defects unpatched.

rejected.reason: defect space is enumerable; open loop invites patch-thrash
one process, five tools; coordination overhead buys nothing
no measured context-overflow case (ai-agent-patterns memory rule)

tools.name: render_probe
tools.side_effects: none (read-only; live render writes only to a temp path)

tools.name: apply_patch
tools.side_effects: writes inside <out>/work/<unit> only; no write path to --root exists
when_not_to_use: second repair pass on a unit

tools.name: package_skill
tools.side_effects: writes <out>/packages/<name>-v<version>.skill; deletes its own emission on preflight STOP
when_not_to_use: units with unprobed or probe-failed patches

failure_policy.probe_fail: revert patch from pristine copy; log S1; do not package
failure_policy.packaging_stop_after_patch: do not emit; log S1; keep working copy

handoff.save_back: human action; verify installed on-disk version before overwrite
